text: dsh-wechat-article 是一个 DSH 插件，提供微信公众号文章制作工具。它在 DSH 工具注册表中提供 Markdown 转公众号 HTML、封面图生成和草稿推送能力：可按公众号编辑器要求生成内联样式 HTML，支持标题、段落、列表、表格、图片和代码块；可生成 900×383 封面；还可上传文章图片、创建草稿并读回核对。适合需要在 DSH 中整理公众号文章并存入草稿箱的用户。推送需要微信公众号 AppID 和 AppSecret，以及草稿箱权限；内容和图片会发送至微信接口。插件只创建草稿，不执行发布。

dsh-wechat-article formats Markdown for WeChat Official Accounts in DSH, renders a 900×383 cover, and saves drafts with read-back verification. Pushing requires account credentials and sends article content and images to WeChat APIs. It does not publish.
想把 Markdown 文章排版成适合微信公众号编辑器的格式。
能不能在 DSH 里生成公众号文章封面并保存为草稿？
I want to turn a Markdown article into a formatted WeChat Official Account draft from DSH.
dsh-wechat-article 的功能「公众号 HTML 排版」：将 Markdown 转成内联样式 HTML，并提供统计和编辑提示。调用 wechat_draft，输入文本或工作区文件路径，可输出预览文件。
dsh-wechat-article 的功能「推送公众号草稿」：将文章和封面提交到草稿箱并读回核对。调用 wechat_push，提供标题及 Markdown 或 HTML 内容；本地图片也可上传。
dsh-wechat-article 使用 wechat_push 时会将文章内容和封面、所选图片发送到 api.weixin.qq.com，以创建微信公众号草稿；需要 AppID、AppSecret 和草稿箱权限。

Turn Markdown into a WeChat Official Account (公众号) **draft** from inside [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — inline-style HTML, a 2.35:1 cover card, and a draft-box push that reads itself back. Zero dependencies.

dsh-wechat-article README · dsh-wechat-article：> **This is an article production chain, not an IM bridge.** `dsh-wechat` (a different, unrelated package) connects an iLink bot to dsh for chat. This plugin never touches messages — it takes a Markdown file and produces a publishable article draft.

dsh-wechat-article README · What it does：| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `wechat_draft` | Markdown → WeChat-editor-safe HTML: every rule inline, no `<style>`, no `class`, images centred with captions, tables wrapped for horizontal scroll |
| `wechat_cover` | 900x383 (2.35:1) cover card PNG — kicker, wrapped title, subtitle, four-colour chip row |
| `wechat_push` | Create a draft in the 草稿箱 with a generated cover, upload local/`data:` images to the WeChat CDN (`media/uploadimg`, deduplicated by content hash) and rewrite their `src` to `mmbiz.qpic.cn`, then read the draft back and verify title + content length |
dsh-wechat-article README · What it does：The chain ends at the **draft box**. Nothing in this plugin publishes: 发表 is a decision for the human who owns the account.

dsh-wechat-article README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-wechat-article
```

Or straight from GitHub:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:alitrack/dsh-wechat-article
```

dsh-wechat-article README · Credentials：`wechat_draft` and `wechat_cover` need no credentials at all. `wechat_push` needs an AppID/AppSecret pair with the 草稿箱 permission (a verified 订阅号/服务号):

```bash

dsh-wechat-article README · option A — environment：export DSH_WECHAT_APPID=wx...
export DSH_WECHAT_APPSECRET=...

dsh-wechat-article README · option B — local file (recommended for a desktop agent)：mkdir -p ~/.dsh-wechat
printf '{"appId":"wx...","appSecret":"..."}' > ~/.dsh-wechat/credentials.json
chmod 600 ~/.dsh-wechat/credentials.json
```

Overrides: `DSH_WECHAT_CREDENTIALS` points at a different file; `DSH_WECHAT_CHROME` pins the Chrome/Chromium binary used for covers.
section: option B — local file (recommended for a desktop agent)

text: dsh-wechat-article README · option B — local file (recommended for a desktop agent)：**Credentials are never accepted as tool arguments.** That is deliberate: tool arguments travel through the model's context, the session transcript and the tool-call log. If the model could pass an AppSecret, the secret would end up in all three.
section: option B — local file (recommended for a desktop agent)

dsh-wechat-article README · The credential gate：`wechat_push` is **only registered when credentials resolve**. Without them the plugin mounts
`wechat_draft` and `wechat_cover` alone (both are pure local work — no network), and adds a system-prompt
section naming the exact fix. The reason is the same reason dsh's own patches disable rows: a tool that
can only ever return `WECHAT_NOT_CONFIGURED` still costs the model a turn to discover that, and it competes
for attention with the tools that do work. An absent tool plus one sentence in the prompt beats a tool that
always fails.
dsh-wechat-article README · The credential gate：```bash

dsh-wechat-article README · Escape hatch — register push anyway (useful for a dry_run check in CI):：export DSH_WECHAT_GATE=off
```

`DSH_WECHAT_GATE=off` restores the old always-registered behaviour, in which a real push fails with a
structured `WECHAT_NOT_CONFIGURED` error instead of disappearing — `dry_run: true` still validates content,
limits and cover without touching the network. The gate is evaluated once at mount time, so adding
credentials requires a dsh restart (dsh has no hot reload for a plugin's tool surface).
section: Escape hatch — register push anyway (useful for a dry_run check in CI):

text: dsh-wechat-article README · Escape hatch — register push anyway (useful for a dry_run check in CI):：WeChat also requires the calling IP to be whitelisted (公众号后台 → 开发 → 基本配置 → IP白名单). A `40164` error means exactly that, and the plugin says so instead of echoing `invalid ip`.

dsh-wechat-article README · Usage：Ask the agent, or call the tools directly:

```
1. wechat_draft  markdown_path=/ws/article.md out_path=/ws/out/article.html
2. wechat_cover  title="一条命令推到草稿箱" out_path=/ws/out/cover.png
3. wechat_push   title="…" markdown_path=/ws/article.md
```

dsh-wechat-article README · Usage：`wechat_push` also accepts `html=` (the fragment `wechat_draft` returned), `thumb_media_id=` (an existing cover), or `cover_path=`; with none of them it generates and uploads a cover itself. `dry_run=true` validates titles, digests, limits and the cover without touching the network.

dsh-wechat-article README · Supported Markdown：Headings, paragraphs, emphasis, inline code, fenced code (with a language label), blockquotes, ordered/unordered lists with two levels of nesting, GFM tables with alignment, images, `---`, and the `:::tip / :::info / :::warning / :::danger` callout syntax. Frontmatter (`title`, `author`, `digest`, `summary`) feeds the draft's metadata. Anything outside this subset degrades to text rather than disappearing.

dsh-wechat-article README · Two cover renderers：1. **headless Chrome/Chromium** (auto-detected) — real font stack, so CJK titles render. Snap-packaged Chromium works: the renderer stages its files where a confined snap can actually write, and verifies the PNG's dimensions before accepting it.
2. **built-in rasteriser** (`lib/png.js` + `lib/font5x7.js`) — always available, no Chrome needed. Draws the full card, but only has glyphs for digits and uppercase Latin; a CJK title comes back with a `CJK_TEXT_NOT_RENDERED` warning instead of boxes.
dsh-wechat-article README · Two cover renderers：Both produce a real 900x383 PNG, and both stay under WeChat's 64KB thumb-material cap.

dsh-wechat-article README · Security model：- **Workspace confinement.** Every path is absolute and must resolve inside the calling session's workspace (`exec.agent.session.header.cwd`). `..` traversal, symlinks pointing outside, absolute paths outside the root, directories and missing files are rejected with distinct error codes.
- **No publish path.** Only `draft/add` and `draft/get` are implemented; `freepublish` is not.
- **Idempotent pushes.** The same title+content hash is pushed once per workspace — a retrying agent cannot flood the draft box. State lives in `<workspace>/.dsh-wechat/state.json` (0600) and is capped at 200 entries.
- **Deduplicated image uploads.** Content images are uploaded via `media/uploadimg` (they do not consume the permanent-material quota) and cached by the sha256 of their bytes, so re-pushing a revised draft does not re-upload unchanged figures. Missing or unresolvable image paths are reported as warnings, never silently dropped.
- **Rate limiting.** Consecutive pushes are spaced by at least 2s, and the plugin never retries in a loop on `45009`.
- **Read-back verification.** A 200 from `draft/add` means "accepted", not "correct". The plugin immediatel

dsh-wechat-article README · Editorial pre-flight：- no images at all (a wall of text),
- images not hosted on `mmbiz.qpic.cn` (the editor strips external images on save),
- external `<a href>` links (unverified accounts lose them on publish),
- tables wider than four columns,
- placeholder tokens (`[[待写]]`, `TODO`, `待补`),
- **numeric consistency**: the same quantity written two ways (`1,234` vs `1234`), a unit whose values span ≥1000x (usually 人 vs 人次, or 总数 vs 子集), large numbers with no unit, and numbers that appear only once and therefore cannot cross-check anything.
dsh-wechat-article README · Editorial pre-flight：The numbers check is a checklist generator, not a fact checker — it surfaces candidates, the author decides.

dsh-wechat-article README · Local development：```bash
npm install --no-save @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools@0.0.1-rc.1
node --test                      # 77 unit tests
node tests/e2e/keyless.mjs       # contract + guards, no model, no network
```

YAML overlays avoid pnpm entirely during development:

```yaml

dsh-wechat-article README · local-overlay.yml：- insert:
    - id: dsh-wechat-article
      name: '/absolute/path/to/dsh-wechat-article/index.js'
```

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2 --patch ./local-overlay.yml "把 article.md 排成公众号 HTML"
```

Full headless e2e (real dsh runtime + a **local** OpenAI-compatible model, so no API key): `bash tests/e2e/run_e2e.sh`.

dsh-wechat-article README · Version gate：dsh refuses to load a plugin whose `peerDependencies` do not match the runtime. This plugin declares `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools: ^0.0.1-rc.1` and is tested against dsh `0.2.1-rc.2`. The exemption is a profile-local `compatibility.json` mapping an exact `name@version` to exact dsh versions — `dsh plugin allow-version` is not a real command, despite the error message suggesting it.

dsh-wechat-article README · Limitations (honest list)：- **Drafts only.** No publish, no comment settings management beyond the create-time flags, no material library management.
- **Remote images are not fetched.** Local paths and `data:` URLs are uploaded automatically; `http(s)` images must already be on `mmbiz.qpic.cn` — download the file and reference it locally if not. `upload_images=false` opts out of uploading entirely.
- **No syntax highlighting.** Code blocks get one dark palette, not per-token colours.
- **CJK covers need Chrome.** Without it you get a clean card with an ASCII title and an explicit warning.
- **Chinese-only account model.** WeChat's draft API limits (64-char title, 16-char author, 120-char digest, 1MB content) are enforced locally so failures surface before a network call.
